Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Yakuza won (Frank, dead Erin, Mallory as Turncoat; Alice left early with a Hitman win), mostly through vote arithmetic rather than kills. The Village started well. Niaj's profile broke Ivan's Lookout cover, Judy's watch and Olivia's (false) track broke his switch to Census Taker, and Ivan was hanged on Day 2. Bob's census (Evil 2 of 3 in Carol/Frank/Ivan) exposed Frank. On Night 2 Dave's two-target Enforce killed Erin, the Katana holder. After that the Village never landed another hang. Five players' trial votes always counted Innocent: Heidi (Merciful, stated openly), Olivia (Arsonist, Merciful but never said so, and claimed Guilty), Alice (Hitman, said Guilty but voted Innocent after Frank's PM), Mallory (Turncoat) and Frank himself. Frank's Day 3 trial failed 3-5, and every later trial failed too. The town then spent nominations on 'Fixer tests' for a Fixer that did not exist. Olivia's lies about her votes fed Frank and Mallory's case against her. The Yakuza played the nights well. They killed the Census Taker and forged his will to cast doubt, held the Katana back on Night 3 when Dave was expected to Enforce Frank, and Mallory's Strong protection on Night 5 stopped Olivia's ignite on Frank. Olivia's ignite killed Niaj, an anti-Yakuza voter, instead of Frank. Frank then killed Heidi, and Frank and Mallory hanged Olivia 2-1 on Day 7.

Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: medium, prompt problemThe harness logged '[ERROR tips_stale] tips/tips.md was last checked against an older version of the rules'. Even so, all 13 players were given that tips file, so their advice may have contradicted the current rules.
Review: low, moderator errorNight 4: Judy (Lookout, not role-blocked) watched Olivia, but the moderator's visit list included only Frank->Judy, Mallory->Frank and Olivia->Frank and left out Judy->Olivia. The night check flagged it. Judy's own result ('Nobody visited her') was correct, and no role that reads visits (Fortune Teller, Cartographer, Scout, Insomniac) was alive, so nothing changed.
Review: low, player confusionDay 7: Frank told Mallory privately, 'Her Remorseful threat can't touch a Turncoat. Ignore it.' This misreads the traits. Turncoat doesn't protect against Remorseful, which kills a Remorseful player who votes Guilty on any hanged Village player. Mallory's Guilty vote was safe only because Olivia wasn't Village (she was the Arsonist), not because Mallory was a Turncoat.
Game over
